title: KittyQuest
tagline: KittyQuest is a Web3 crowdfunding app aimed at raising money for real cats.
description: Join the adventure in saving real cats! KittyQuest is a Web3-powered crowdfunding platform where passionate cat lovers can unite to raise money for real-life feline welfare. With the power of blockchain, you can support shelters, rescues, and adoption efforts while being part of a virtual cat game. Collect, raise funds, and help make the world a better place for our furry friends. Let's embark on a quest to improve the lives of cats together!
